summary: Frontend-only testing of Four Lost Cats landing page on desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844). All 15 review checklist items pass. Loader auto-dismisses in ~2.5s, page becomes scrollable, hero/nav/menu/events/visit/instagram/footer sections render correctly, nav smooth-scroll via Lenis works, menu tab switching works (7 tabs, filtered items), all CTAs have correct hrefs (tel:, instagram, zomato, google maps), no broken images, no horizontal overflow on mobile, mobile CTA bar + hamburger menu overlay function correctly. No console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: Mobile menu overlay nav links (Navbar.jsx lines 108-120) do not carry data-testid attributes. Desktop nav-* testids are only in the desktop nav bar, so scoped mobile nav testing must select via href. Consider adding matching data-testid to mobile menu links for easier E2E.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use ?nointro to bypass 2.5s loader for faster tests. Programmatic scroll must go via window.__lenis.scrollTo(y,{immediate:true}) because Lenis hijacks window.scrollTo. Mobile menu overlay links do not have data-testid — select with `[data-testid='mobile-menu'] a[href='#menu']`. Desktop tested at 1920x1080, mobile at 390x844.
